accounts.name: authority
docs: W-024: address-pinned at constraint level — defense in depth so a
future handler refactor cannot accidentally skip the authority check.

instructions.name: atomic_fill_from_relay
docs: v4 RFQ Relay — atomic 1-ix fill consumed by the relay WebSocket server
(`skew-relay/`). Replaces `create_rfq`+`fill_rfq`+`cancel_rfq` with a
single, Ed25519-verified fill. Two Ed25519 verify instructions (buyer
sig + CM sig) MUST precede this instruction in the same tx.
Phase B live (founder consolidation 2026-04-26): full Ed25519 sig
verification, SPL CPI (collateral + premium + fee), Metaplex, CM update.
See `docs/interfaces/relay-payload-v1.md` for the authoritative payload
byte layout shared with the infra `skew-relay/` server.

accounts.name: option
docs: The OptionAccount this instruction creates and funds in one shot.
Seeds pin the option PDA to the seller CM + relay_nonce so replay
attacks across CMs are impossible.
`Box<Account<…>>` lifts the 264 B account body to the heap so
`try_accounts` stays inside the 4 KB BPF stack limit.

accounts.name: seller_cm

route premium to an attacker-controlled account. Mirrors the
`token::authority = option.creator` guard in `buy_option.rs`.

accounts.name: fee_accumulator
docs: Skew fee accumulator PDA (receives the taker fee).

accounts.name: seller_collateral_ata

accounts.name: option_escrow

accounts.name: auction
docs: **W-024 (2026-04-26) — close on fill**. Pre-fix the AuctionAccount
stayed alive after `fill_auction`, blocking any future re-auction
of the same option (PDA seed collision on `[AUCTION_SEED, option]`).
`close = seller` reclaims the rent + frees the seed slot so the
new holder can immediately re-list. The AuctionFilled event captures
the historical record (filled_price / filled_at / filled_by) for
off-chain indexers; on-chain we don't keep the closed PDA's body.
`has_one = seller` pins the rent refund to the original lister so a
malicious buyer cannot redirect it.

accounts.name: seller
docs: **W-024 close-rent target** — must match `auction.seller`.
SystemAccount so Anchor accepts it as a `close = X` destination
without requiring a signer (anyone can fill the auction; the rent
just goes to the original lister regardless of who calls).

accounts.name: proposal
docs: Per-proposal PDA — id = `governance.next_proposal_id` BEFORE
increment. Seeds locked at the snapshotted id so the PDA is
reproducible off-chain.
SAFETY: the seed `next_id_le` is computed from
`governance.next_proposal_id.to_le_bytes()` AT INVOCATION; the
handler bumps the counter only after the proposal init succeeds
so a failed init does not skip an id slot.

accounts.name: authority
docs: W-028: address-pinned at constraint level so no other signer can race to

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Dutch-auction partial liquidation (Phase B Task #8).
Off-chain `skew-liq-bot` calls this when a CM's equity ratio < 1.10.
Bonus linear ramps 2% → 10% over 60s; partial close cap 50%; Bug #17
insolvency guard cascades through `default_waterfall_drain` when the
payout exceeds CM posted collateral.
Phase B live (founder consolidation 2026-04-26): Dutch auction partial
close with adaptive Lyapunov fraction (§12.5) + post-check equity guard.

accounts.name: if_escrow

instructions.name: update_cross_asset_matrix
docs: Cross-asset ρ matrix writer (spec §23.9). 10 P5 ρ pairs (×1e6) +
10 stress ρ pairs ordered by `LAUNCH_PAIR_INDICES`. `update_p5` /
`update_stress` flags select subset; both may fire in one call.
Daily cadence — emits `CrossAssetMatrixUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_hamilton_state
docs: Hamilton 2-state filter writer (spec §25.4). Pushes the live
posterior `(π_calm, π_stress)` + transition matrix + debounce
counters per asset. Emits `HamiltonStateUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_microstructure
docs: Multi-venue microstructure attest writer (spec §29.9). 60-slot
cadence; SKEW_AUTHORITY signs after polling Binance / Bybit / OKX.
Emits `MicrostructureUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_povs_state
docs: PoVS streaming state writer (spec §3.2 9-step output). 12 µ-scaled
values per asset — pushed by the off-chain pipeline running EWMA σ_t /
YZ σ_∞ / Heston θ_d / AR(1) VRP / POT-GPD ξ-β / VaR_99 / ES_999 /
Hamilton r_t. Emits `PoVSStateUpdated`.

v4 시그니처 — BTC/ETH/SOL long/short (6) + update flags (2) + altcoin RV
(JUP/BONK/WIF/SOL from Birdeye) + update_rv flag + W-010 XRP/HYPE

instructions.name: update_skew_metrics
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY-only crank for per-asset SSVI advisor metrics
(PoVS spec §31.5 P07 + §31.6 P08): RR25 / BF25 / RR10 / ATM slope +
7-tenor IV. 1h cadence; NOT timelocked (Phase 2 multisig in
`governance_security`). 8 IV args correspond to spec §7.7 standard
tenors `{7, 14, 21, 28, 60, 90, 180, 365}` days — passed as discrete
u64 args (not an array) because Anchor's `#[program]` macro doesn't
re-export array-typed instruction args cleanly into the IDL.

types.name: AdminAction
docs: Admin actions queued through `governance_propose`, gated by ≥3/5 multisig
+ 24h timelock + 1h signature age check. **Every** variant — including
`PauseProtocol` — passes through the 24h timelock; only the spec §15.7
circuit-breaker (off-chain monitoring service) is permitted to bypass.
`ListAsset` carries the new asset's parameters because at proposal time
the asset is, by definition, NOT yet in the canonical [`crate::state::
asset::Asset`] enum. The 5-asset launch panel (BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/HYPE) is
already enrolled — `ListAsset` proposals therefore start with the
post-launch panel expansion (Tier-3+ assets / factory candidate
promotion). Adding to the enum is a code-deploy + IDL redeploy step that
follows successful execution of this proposal.

fields.name: pyth_feed
docs: Pyth price feed pubkey (canonical asset identifier pre-enrolment).

fields.name: tier
docs: 1 = Tier 1 / 2 = Tier 2 (matches `Tier` enum discriminant).

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol bytes (length-6 right-padded ASCII).

fields.name: p_max_floor_bps
docs: IM scenario shock × 1e4 (bps). Phase B OPT 2.

fields.name: liq_premium_bps
docs: Liquidity premium × 1e4 (bps). Spec §10.8.

fields.name: filled_price
docs: Populated on fill — matches `AuctionFilled` event.

types.name: AuctionCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_auction` (seller-triggered before fill).

types.name: AuctionFilled
docs: Emitted by `fill_auction`. `fill_price` is the auction-computed current
price at the fill slot (start_price minus linear decay, clamped to floor).

types.name: AuctionStarted
docs: Emitted by `start_auction`. Off-chain bots + UIs subscribe to build the
live secondary-market book.

types.name: CMRegistered
docs: Emitted by `register_clearing_member`. Indexer adds the CM to the CM roster.

types.name: ClearingMemberAccount
docs: Clearing Member account. Every writer of options must register as a CM
and post initial collateral. Net notional exposure and concentration
caps are tracked here.
PDA seeds: `[crate::state::CM_SEED, authority.key()]`

fields.name: collateral
docs: Total USDC posted to CM escrow (lamports / 1e6 USDC).

fields.name: if_contribution
docs: Portion of `collateral` earmarked to Insurance Fund Tier-2 per-CM contribution.

fields.name: net_notional_long
docs: Net long notional in USDC lamports across all open positions.

fields.name: net_notional_short
docs: Net short notional in USDC lamports.

fields.name: positions_count
docs: Count of OptionAccounts where `holder == self.authority` and state ∈ {Funded, Active}.

fields.name: last_margin_check
docs: Unix ts of the last margin sufficiency check (updated by calculate_margin).

fields.name: under_liquidation
docs: Flagged insolvent by liquidate.rs; locks new position opens.

fields.name: kyc_passed
docs: Optional KYC flag (Phase 2). Phase 1 = false, permissionless.

fields.name: last_im_micro
docs: **W-006 (mainnet blocker fix, 2026-04-26)** — last `compute_im` output
in USDC micro-units, written by `calculate_margin`. Read by
`liquidate.rs` to gate the auction on `is_below_liq_trigger`. Without
this snapshot, `liquidate` had no way to verify the CM was actually
undercollateralised → anyone could liquidate any healthy CM and pocket
the Dutch bonus + collateral payout.

types.name: CollateralDeposited
docs: Emitted by `deposit_collateral`. Indexer flips listing to `Funded`.

types.name: CrossAssetMatrix
docs: Cross-asset correlation matrix store (singleton PDA).
`icc_rho_p5_micro` and `stress_rho_micro` indexed by [`LAUNCH_PAIR_INDICES`]
— values are ρ × 1e6, range [0, 1_000_000].
Total `repr(C)` size:
8     last_fit_slot              =      8 B
40    icc_rho_p5_micro [u32; 10] =     40 B
40    stress_rho_micro [u32; 10] =     40 B
8     last_pearson_slot          =      8 B
8     last_stress_slot           =      8 B
1+7   bump + padding             =      8 B
total                            =    112 B (+ 8 B Anchor discriminator)

fields.name: last_fit_slot
docs: Slot of the most recent successful update (any kind).

fields.name: icc_rho_p5_micro
docs: 10-entry P5 rolling 180d ρ × 1e6 (spec §18.4 production values).

fields.name: stress_rho_micro
docs: 10-entry stress regime ρ × 1e6 (spec §10.7 / §23.6).

fields.name: last_pearson_slot
docs: Slot of the last weekly Pearson + tail-dep refresh (spec §23.9 weekly).

fields.name: last_stress_slot
docs: Slot of the last daily stress-ρ refresh (spec §23.9 daily).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: padding_0
docs: Padding to 8-byte alignment.

types.name: CrossAssetMatrixUpdated
docs: Emitted by the cross-asset matrix update crank (spec §23.9). Off-chain
bots subscribe to know when ρ table refreshed (daily cadence). Body
carries P5 ρ basis points × 1e4 for the 10 launch-panel pairs.

fields.name: rho_p5_bps
docs: Flat 10-pair ρ_P5 × 1e4 ordered as
`[BTC-ETH, BTC-SOL, BTC-XRP, BTC-HYPE,
ETH-SOL, ETH-XRP, ETH-HYPE,
SOL-XRP, SOL-HYPE,
XRP-HYPE]`.

types.name: DefaultAbsorbed
docs: Emitted per waterfall step by `default_waterfall_drain`. Indexer records
the tier-by-tier drain so the audit trail is reconstructible off-chain.

types.name: DutchAuctionStepped
docs: Emitted each Dutch-auction ramp tick. Off-chain liq-bot uses this to
decide whether to attempt a liquidation at the current bonus level.

fields.name: current_bonus_bps
docs: Current bonus (bps), computed from `(now - liq_start_ts)` against
constants::DUTCH_START_BPS..DUTCH_END_BPS over DUTCH_RAMP_SECS.

types.name: FeeWithdrawn
docs: Emitted by `withdraw_fees`. Records protocol fee withdrawals.

types.name: GovernanceMultisig
docs: Council of 5 signers + threshold (≥ 3) + last-rotation slot.
Spec §15.3 line 1873-1878. Initialised by `init_governance` (one-shot, an
authority-only instruction in the v4 deploy script).

fields.name: members
docs: 5 signer pubkeys. Lower index = higher rotation priority.

fields.name: threshold
docs: Required signature count (≥ MULTISIG_THRESHOLD = 3).

fields.name: padding_0
docs: Padding to align last_rotation_slot.

fields.name: last_rotation_slot
docs: Solana slot of the last `RotateMultisigMember` execution.

fields.name: next_proposal_id
docs: Next proposal id (increments on each `governance_propose`).

fields.name: paused
docs: Protocol pause flag. Set by `PauseProtocol` action.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: padding_1
docs: Padding to 8-byte alignment.

types.name: HamiltonState
docs: Per-asset 2-state regime filter live state.
Layout (after Anchor 8-byte discriminator):
1+1+6  asset + bump + padding_0    =  8
8      last_update_slot            =  8
8      pi_calm_micro               =  8
8      pi_stress_micro             =  8
8      mu_calm_micro (i64)         =  8
8      mu_stress_micro (i64)       =  8
8      sigma_calm_micro            =  8
8      sigma_stress_micro          =  8
8      p01_micro                   =  8
8      p10_micro                   =  8
4+4    consecutive_stress_days +
consecutive_calm_days       =  8  (debounce, spec §25.9)
Total                              = 88 B + 8 B discriminator = 96 B

fields.name: asset
docs: Asset discriminant (`Asset::to_u8()`).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: Last `update_state` slot to write this account.

fields.name: pi_calm_micro
docs: Posterior π_calm × 1e6. Initialised to the stationary distribution.

fields.name: pi_stress_micro
docs: Posterior π_stress × 1e6. Invariant: `pi_calm + pi_stress = 1_000_000`.

fields.name: mu_calm_micro
docs: Live MLE-fitted parameters (refreshed via `UpdateHamiltonParams`).
Init values come from `oracle::hamilton_init_prior(asset_idx)`.

fields.name: consecutive_stress_days
docs: Spec §25.9 — debounce counters. A single-day π_stress > 0.5 spike
followed by reset is treated as calm; only ≥ `HAMILTON_DEBOUNCE_DAYS`
consecutive stress days trip the regime indicator.

types.name: HamiltonStateUpdated
docs: Emitted by the Hamilton 2-state filter step (spec §25.4). `pi_stress_micro`
is the continuous regime indicator `r_t` consumed by `twiv_window_eff_slots`
+ ScanRisk vol multiplier dispatch.

types.name: IFDeposited
docs: Emitted by `deposit_to_if`. Indexer updates tier balances.

types.name: IfTier
docs: Insurance Fund tier identifier. Discriminant = `to_le_bytes()` value
used in `[b"if_pool", &tier.to_le_bytes()]` PDA seeds (spec §33.1.3).
**V3 schema-break note (2026-04-25 Day 6, 파운더 컨펌):** Tier-2 is the
non-defaulting Tier-2 asset cluster (XRP/HYPE post-Day-14, BTC/ETH/SOL
pre-Day-14 don't sit in Tier-2). The legacy comment "JUP/BONK/WIF" no
longer applies under the V3 5-asset launch panel; factory-pattern
long-tails (JUP/BONK/WIF) are isolated to a separate factory IF outside
this on-chain singleton.

types.name: InsuranceFund
docs: Singleton Insurance Fund PDA. Tracks segregated balances per default-waterfall
tier. Drain is performed by `default_waterfall.rs` — this struct is a state
holder only.
PDA seeds: `[crate::state::IF_SEED]` (singleton).

fields.name: tier3_protocol_sitg
docs: Protocol's own capital pledged before mutualized pool is tapped.
Phase 1 seed target: $5M USDC lamports (devnet: $5k simulated).

fields.name: total_cm_contributions
docs: Tracked separately from mutualized pools so `default_waterfall` can
distinguish the defaulting-CM's contribution (Tier-2) from other CMs' (Tier-4).

types.name: IvHistoryEntry
docs: Per-day rolling IV / VRP observation record.
Total `repr(C)` size: 8 + 8 + 8 = **24 bytes** (8-byte aligned, no padding).
Used as element type of [`PoVSState::iv_history`] ring buffer.
`Default` is implemented manually (not derived) so that tests/clients can
build a zero-initialised entry without invoking `Pod::zeroed`.

fields.name: date_unix
docs: Unix timestamp of the observation (UTC midnight, day granularity).

fields.name: iv_micro
docs: PoVS forecast IV at this date, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: vrp_rel_micro
docs: Realised vrp_rel (= IV² · T / θ_T − 1) at this date, scaled by 1e6 (signed).

types.name: LiquidationExecuted
docs: Emitted by `liquidate`. One emission per partial-close step. `close_factor_bps`
identifies the fraction of the position closed in this step (≤5000).

fields.name: bonus_bps
docs: Dutch-auction bonus applied at this step (basis points of collateral).

fields.name: payout
docs: Collateral transferred to the liquidator (post-bonus).

fields.name: remaining_equity
docs: Defaulting CM equity after the step (sanity — must be ≥ 0 by insolvency guard).

types.name: LiquidationState
docs: Tracks the auction timer + cumulative close factor for one option.
Created on the first `liquidate` call that targets a given option; closed
when the option is fully liquidated (sum of close factors = 10_000 bps).
PDA seeds: `[LIQ_STATE_SEED, option.key()]`.

fields.name: total_closed_bps
docs: Cumulative close factor drained across successive partial-liq calls
on the same option. Bounded at 10_000 bps (fully closed).

types.name: MarginCalculated
docs: Emitted by `calculate_margin`. PM v1.4 master formula result + breakdown +
portfolio Greeks (spec §10.1 / §10.11 — `IM_final = max(ScanRisk, Boundary)
· (1+L_a) · (1+C_P) + TailAddOn − ICCcredit`).
Component breakdown lets external bots / dashboards query the full
formula without re-running compute_im. Portfolio Greeks (Δ_$ / Γ_$ /
V_$ / Θ_day) are emitted as a free byproduct so MM/hedge bots can run
delta-neutral logic off a single subscription.

fields.name: max_loss_usdc
docs: Final IM in USDC micro-units (PM v1.4 master formula output).

fields.name: base_im_micro
docs: `max(scan_risk, boundary)` before liquidity / concentration multipliers.

fields.name: scan_risk_micro
docs: 60-scenario worst loss across the portfolio (spec §10.2).

fields.name: boundary_micro
docs: Σ_{short bounded} |q|·(M − V_0) (spec §10.3, Bug #1 fix).

fields.name: l_a_applied_bps
docs: Per-asset L_a weighted average, in basis points (spec §10.8).

fields.name: c_p_applied_bps
docs: Concentration haircut applied, in basis points (spec §10.9, capped 50%).

fields.name: icc_credit_micro
docs: Σ_{(a,b) opposite-Δ, ρ>0.4} 0.3·ρ·min(|Δ_$|) (spec §10.5).

fields.name: portfolio_delta_dollar_micro
docs: Net Δ-dollar exposure × 1e6. Sign: positive = long-spot net.

fields.name: portfolio_gamma_dollar_micro
docs: Net Γ-dollar exposure × 1e6.

fields.name: portfolio_vega_dollar_micro
docs: Net Vega-dollar exposure × 1e6 (per 1.0 σ).

fields.name: portfolio_theta_day_micro
docs: Net Θ per day, USDC micro.

types.name: MicrostructurePDA
docs: Per-asset microstructure snapshot. Layout matches spec §29.9 byte-for-byte
(with explicit padding for `repr(C)` 8-byte alignment).
Field semantics (spec §29.1 — 5-asset launch panel reference Apr 2026):
* `spot_micro`            — last-trade USD spot × 1e6
* `bid_ask_spread_bps`    — best-bid/best-ask spread on the deepest venue,
in bps of mid (spec §10.8 / §29.2 L_a derive)
* `depth_100k_usd_micro`  — orderbook depth ($) within ±$100k of mid;
spec §29.4 input to `liquidation_slippage_factor`
* `volume_24h_usd_micro`  — rolling 24-h notional volume × 1e6 (spec §29.5
`MIN_24H_VOLUME_USD` listing-eligibility floor)
* `iv_bid_28d_micro`      — ATM 28d implied vol (bid side) × 1e6
* `iv_ask_28d_micro`      — ATM 28d implied vol (ask side) × 1e6
(`bid_ask_spread_bps` derived from these for
IV-side spread per spec §29.8 SSVI cross-check)
Total `repr(C)` size:
1+7   asset + padding_0           =     8 B
8     last_update_slot            =     8 B
8     spot_micro                  =     8 B
4+4   bid_ask_spread_bps + pad    =     8 B
8     depth_100k_usd_micro        =     8 B
8     volume_24h_usd_micro        =     8 B
8     iv_bid_28d_micro            =     8 B
8     iv_ask_28d_micro            =     8 B
total                             =    64 B  (+ 8 B Anchor discriminator)

fields.name: asset
docs: Asset discriminant (= [`crate::state::asset::Asset`] `to_u8()`).

fields.name: padding_0
docs: Reserved for future flags (alignment padding to next u64).

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: Solana slot of the last attest.

fields.name: spot_micro
docs: Last-trade spot, USD × 1e6.

fields.name: bid_ask_spread_bps
docs: Best bid/ask spread (deepest venue), bps of mid. spec §10.8 L_a derive.

fields.name: padding_1
docs: Padding to 8-byte alignment.

fields.name: depth_100k_usd_micro
docs: Depth $ within ±$100k of mid, scaled by 1e6 (spec §29.4 slippage input).

fields.name: volume_24h_usd_micro
docs: 24-hour rolling notional volume (USD × 1e6) (spec §29.5 listing floor).

fields.name: iv_bid_28d_micro
docs: ATM 28-day implied vol, bid side × 1e6.

fields.name: iv_ask_28d_micro
docs: ATM 28-day implied vol, ask side × 1e6.

types.name: MicrostructureUpdated
docs: Emitted by the multi-venue microstructure attest (spec §29.9). Indexer
rebuilds spot/spread/depth/24h-vol/IV bid-ask time series.

fields.name: settled
docs: Single flag covering both `settled_price` and `settled_at`. While false,
the two i64 fields below are undefined (0 is a legitimate Pyth price
value, so a sentinel does not work).

fields.name: metadata
docs: Zero-pubkey sentinel until 앵커2 `buy_option` wires `CreateMetadataAccountV3` CPI.

fields.name: holder
docs: Used by `settle` to route payoff to the correct recipient.
For v4 CM model, `holder` is expected to be a `ClearingMemberAccount.authority`.

fields.name: upper_bound
docs: For RangeAccrual: inclusive upper price bound in Pyth native units.
`strike` acts as the lower bound. Zero sentinel for non-RA types.

fields.name: h_eff
docs: UNUSED post-Decision 32 (OneTouch dropped). Retained as 0.0 sentinel
for append-only Iron Law 5 compatibility until Day 14 IDL v2.0 redeploy
(at which point the slot may be reclaimed in a deliberate layout bump).
Do NOT repurpose on-chain — writers stamp 0.0 unconditionally.

fields.name: asset
docs: Semantic asset tag matching `Asset::to_u8()`. Canonical Pyth feed is
derived off-chain from this tag via the 6-asset allowlist.

fields.name: direction
docs: Payoff direction: +1 = Call, -1 = Put, 0 = n/a (RangeAccrual).

fields.name: extra_param
docs: Type-specific extra parameter:
CappedVanilla → cap (same scale as strike, cast to f64)
Digital / RangeAccrual → 0.0 (unused)
OneTouch barrier usage was removed with Decision 32.

fields.name: spot_at_creation
docs: Spot price at creation, in Pyth native units (same scale as `strike`).
Used with `sigma_at_creation` to derive `v0_usdc_micro` on-chain at
`create_option` and for the Boundary-Aware IM scenario reprice.

fields.name: sigma_at_creation
docs: Annualised σ at creation (0.10 ≤ σ ≤ 3.00 enforced by validation.rs).
Locked at creation to prevent vol-spike margin manipulation (F-PM13).

fields.name: v0_usdc_micro
docs: Fair value V(S_0) at creation, in USDC micro-units (10^6 scale).
`M − V_0` is the Boundary-Aware floor of Initial Margin (Theorem 1):
IM = max(IM_scenario, M − V_0),  M = payoff_amount = required_collateral.
Computed on-chain via `pricing::fair_value_micro_usd`; the client does
not supply this value — it is derived inside `create_option::handler`.

types.name: OptionAdminSettled
docs: Emitted by `admin_settle`. SKEW_AUTHORITY resolved a Disputed option.

types.name: OptionBought
docs: Emitted by `buy_option`. Indexer records buyer, premium, and option-token
mint for portfolio tracking and P&L feed.

types.name: OptionCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_option`. Creator cancelled before first buy.

types.name: OptionClosed
docs: Emitted by `close_expired`.

types.name: OptionCreated
docs: Emitted by `create_option`. Indexer populates the marketplace listing table.

types.name: OptionDisputed
docs: Emitted by `mark_disputed`. 30-min normal window elapsed without settle.

types.name: OptionExpiredAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `expire_abandoned`. Settle window elapsed without settle call.

types.name: OptionRolledOver
docs: Emitted by `rollover_option`.

types.name: OptionSettled
docs: Emitted by `settle`. Records settlement price + routing.

types.name: OptionTransferred
docs: Emitted by `transfer_option` (and by `fill_auction` after its own auction
emit). Indexer flips `OptionAccount.holder` tracking so the settle/payoff
route matches the current SPL-token owner.

types.name: OptionType
docs: Option payoff types. Direction (Call/Put) is carried in
`OptionAccount.direction`. Digital / CappedVanilla / RangeAccrual satisfy
Boundary-Aware Theorem 1 (`sup{payoff} < ∞`). Vanilla is unbounded for
short Call; `compute_im` uses ScanRisk-only path for Vanilla shorts
(see `state::asset::OptionType::is_bounded_payoff`).
OneTouch was removed in Decision 32 (2026-04-24 23:00 KST, 파운더 서명).

types.name: ParamName
docs: Parameter handle for admin parameter updates.  The value range / type for
each variant is documented in `constants/mod.rs` next to the canonical
constant. `governance_execute` (I09) decodes the variant + writes the
matching slot. Adding a new parameter REQUIRES amendment + Day 14+ IDL
redeploy (this is a closed enum — closed-set discipline matches §15.7).

types.name: PoVSState
docs: Per-asset PoVS state vector. Layout matches spec §33.3 byte-for-byte.
Field order is **load-bearing**: changing it breaks all open accounts on
devnet. Padding bytes are explicit so the layout is portable across
Rust compiler revisions and bytemuck-safe.
Total `repr(C)` size:
1+7  asset+padding_0           =     8
8    last_update_slot          =     8
8    sigma_t_micro             =     8
8    sigma_inf_micro           =     8
8    theta_d_micro             =     8
8    vrp_rel_micro (i64)       =     8
8    iv_micro                  =     8
8    p_max_micro               =     8
8    xi_micro (i64)            =     8
8    beta_micro                =     8
8    var_99_micro              =     8
8    es_999_micro              =     8
8    regime_indicator_micro    =     8
2+2+4  returns_{idx,count}+padding_1 =     8
2160 iv_history [IvHistoryEntry; 90] (24×90) = 2160
1+1+6  iv_idx + bump + padding_2     =     8
4+2+2  sigma_inf_window + confidence_bps + padding_3 = 8 (Phase 1505.A.B
spec §3.1 append — adaptive YZ window §4.5 + cold-start flag §6.9)
total                                =  5168 bytes  (+ 8 Anchor discriminator
via `#[account]` = 5176
on-chain rent target)
CU budget: zero_copy load + 9-step `update_state` writes ≈ 6.4 kCU per slot
(spec §3.3, ~3.2% of the 200 kCU per-instruction envelope).

fields.name: asset
docs: Asset discriminant (= [`crate::state::asset::Asset`] `to_u8()`).

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: Solana slot of the last `update_state` write.

fields.name: sigma_t_micro
docs: EWMA σ_t, annualised, scaled by 1e6 (spec §4.1, RiskMetrics λ=0.94).

fields.name: sigma_inf_micro
docs: Yang–Zhang σ_∞ over the adaptive window, annualised, scaled by 1e6

fields.name: theta_d_micro
docs: Heston closed-form θ_d for T = 28d (spec §5.1), scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: vrp_rel_micro
docs: AR(1) 1-step VRP forecast, signed, scaled by 1e6 (spec §6.3).

fields.name: iv_micro
docs: PoVS forecast IV @ ATM 28d (spec §7.1), scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: p_max_micro
docs: Current `p_max` shock floor, scaled by 1e6
(spec §11.3 `p_max_floor` × adjustment).

fields.name: xi_micro
docs: POT-GPD ξ tail index (spec §26.2), signed, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: beta_micro
docs: POT-GPD β scale parameter, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: var_99_micro
docs: VaR_99 from POT-GPD fit, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: es_999_micro
docs: ES_99.9% from POT-GPD fit, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: regime_indicator_micro
docs: Hamilton 2-state filter posterior `r_t ∈ [0, 1]`, scaled by 1e6
(spec §25.2 / §3.2 Step 5). Source-of-truth for the
`regime_indicator` field per amendment §1.8 — `TwivPda` does NOT
store this; 앵커2's `oracle.rs::update_twiv` reads it from here.

fields.name: returns_buf
docs: 720-day ring buffer of log returns × 1e6.

fields.name: returns_idx
docs: Next-write index into [`Self::returns_buf`].

fields.name: returns_count
docs: Number of entries currently populated (saturates at [`RETURNS_BUF_LEN`]).

fields.name: iv_history
docs: 90-day ring buffer of (date, IV, vrp_rel) observations.

fields.name: iv_idx
docs: Next-write index into [`Self::iv_history`].

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: sigma_inf_window
docs: Adaptive Yang-Zhang σ_∞ window length in days (spec §4.5).
Discrete domain `{180, 365, 720}` — `update_state` re-evaluates every
180 slots and writes the chosen window here. Default at init = 180
(most-recent regime; slow-roll out to 365/720 as `returns_count`
grows past the corresponding thresholds).

fields.name: confidence_bps
docs: Cold-start flag in bps (0 = cold, 10000 = full). Spec §6.9 / §32.6
Theorem 6 — synthetic IV cold-start ramp. Promoted to `10_000` once
`iv_history.len() == 90` (≥ 90-day high-confidence window). New 5th
asset HYPE (post-launch enrolment) starts at `0` and ramps via
`synth_iv_calibrate` (Phase 1535-Instr10p wrapper, blocked on
skew-pricing workspace decision).

fields.name: padding_3
docs: Padding to 8-byte struct alignment.

types.name: PoVSStateUpdated
docs: Emitted whenever `update_state` (Phase 1509 PoVS 9-step) writes a fresh
PoVSState. Carries the streaming-derived index values so the indexer
can populate per-asset time-series tables without re-reading the 5.2 KB
account.

types.name: ProposalPda
docs: Single queued admin proposal. Created by `governance_propose` (I08),
transitions to executed via `governance_execute` (I09) once
`now_slot ≥ queued_at_slot + TIMELOCK_24H_SLOTS` and `signers ≥ threshold`.

fields.name: id
docs: Sequence id from `GovernanceMultisig.next_proposal_id` at proposal time.

fields.name: queued_at_slot
docs: Slot at which the proposal was queued (= timelock anchor).

fields.name: executed_at_slot
docs: Slot at which the proposal was executed (0 = pending).

fields.name: approvals_bitmap
docs: Bitset of which council members (0..5) have approved. Indices map to
`GovernanceMultisig.members`.

fields.name: executed
docs: `true` once `governance_execute` has dispatched the action.

fields.name: padding_0
docs: Padding to 8-byte alignment of `action`.

fields.name: action
docs: The queued action body. Borsh-serialised inline with the PDA.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: padding_1
docs: Trailing padding (zero).

types.name: RelayFillExecuted
docs: Emitted by `atomic_fill_from_relay`. The relay publishes this back to the
WebSocket subscribers so both buyer and seller see the on-chain confirmation
of their off-chain quote.

types.name: RelayPayload
docs: Borsh-serialisable relay payload. Mirrors the schema documented above.
Kept in-module because it is used solely as instruction args; the
canonical public schema lives in `docs/interfaces/relay-payload-v1.md`.

types.name: RfqAccount
docs: RFQ PDA — buyer posts desired option spec + escrowed premium.
Underwriter fills by matching a Funded OptionAccount to the spec.
Seed: `[b"rfq", buyer, nonce.to_le_bytes()]`.

fields.name: upper_bound
docs: For RangeAccrual: upper price bound in Pyth native units. Zero for Digital/Vanilla.

types.name: RfqCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_rfq`. Indexer removes RFQ from open board.

types.name: RfqCreated
docs: Emitted by `create_rfq`. Indexer adds entry to open-RFQ board.

types.name: RfqFilled
docs: Emitted by `fill_rfq`. Indexer marks RFQ filled + records option.

fields.name: underlying_feed
docs: Pyth feed pubkey this sigma tracks. Matches option.underlying_feed_id.

fields.name: prices
docs: Circular price buffer (N_OBS=120 entries). Each entry is the Pyth EMA
price (i64, raw Pyth units) at the time update_sigma was called.

fields.name: head
docs: Index of the next write position (mod 120).

fields.name: count
docs: Number of valid price observations written so far (saturates at 120).

fields.name: sigma_hat
docs: Realised volatility in bps/hr, recomputed after each push.
0.0 when count < 2. Compare against SIGMA_THRESHOLD_BPS_PER_HR (2.7).

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: Solana slot of the last update_sigma call (staleness check in settle).

types.name: SkewMetricsPda
docs: Per-asset SSVI advisor metrics (PoVS spec §31.5 P07 + §31.6 P08).
Layout (after Anchor 8-byte discriminator):
1+1+6  asset + bump + padding_0     =   8
8      last_update_slot             =   8
8      atm_iv_28d_micro             =   8
8      rr25_micro (i64)             =   8
8      bf25_micro (i64)             =   8
8      rr10_micro (i64)             =   8
8      atm_slope_micro (i64)        =   8
8 × 8  iv_per_tenor_micro [8]       =  64
Total body                          = 120 B
With 8 B Anchor discriminator       = 128 B

fields.name: atm_iv_28d_micro
docs: ATM 28d IV (spec §31.6 anchor tenor) × 1e6.

fields.name: rr25_micro
docs: 25Δ Risk Reversal = σ(25ΔC) − σ(25ΔP) × 1e6 (spec §31.5).
Negative under put-skew premium (R8 — universally crypto).

fields.name: bf25_micro
docs: 25Δ Butterfly = (σ(25ΔC) + σ(25ΔP))/2 − σ(ATM) × 1e6 (spec §31.5).

fields.name: rr10_micro
docs: 10Δ Risk Reversal × 1e6 (tail skew, spec §31.5).

fields.name: atm_slope_micro
docs: ATM slope ∂σ/∂k|_{k=0} × 1e6 (spec §31.5).

fields.name: iv_per_tenor_micro
docs: ATM IV per standard tenor × 1e6 (spec §31.6 P08).
Literal `8` (not `SKEW_METRICS_TENOR_COUNT`) because Anchor's
`#[account]` macro can't resolve module-level consts at parse time.
